title: Crispy Duck Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir-fry dish made with duck breast, served with nutty American-style fried rice.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the duck breast and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
3. Remove the duck from the pan and set aside.
4. In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.
5. Add the beaten egg and scramble it until cooked through.
6. Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
7. Add the cooked duck back into the pan, along with the fry seasoning and chopped onions.
8. Stir-fry for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have combined.
